title: Recover a queue ejection before release enrollment
trigger: A queued PR is unmergeable in its train while it remains mergeable against the base, or an item has an open correction landing.
need: Read the snapshotted preceding PRs and shared files. Wait until those entries land or leave, then re-read base mergeability: rebase and re-verify a conflicting head; re-enqueue an unchanged mergeable head through the observer. The server record drives merge --wait and names read failures with recovery. Release admission and containment refuse a current run member's open correction PR until it lands or closes; a member removed from the run never blocks it.
